back.es: la caja = box; also the cash register or checkout in a shop
back.example: You can pay at the checkout (register).

note: The hint "where you pay" separates this card from the "box" card, and Spain also says "caja", so spain is correctly null. The trick's "cash-a" is only a loose sound match, because the j in caja is said like a breathy h (KAH-ha), not like "sh".
